title: Portrait lockup / Clear space
slide_intent: Reserve a boundary around a stacked signature because nearby content can compete with both mascot and name.
strategic_value: A protected portrait lockup can keep Duolingo’s recognition cues together and visible.
demonstration: The portrait lockup is shown inside a marked clearance diagram with a prohibition on objects in that area.
practical_value: Preserve the diagrammed boundary when placing a stacked logo.

content_islands.name: Portrait clearance
content_islands.spec: Keep the stacked logo and its surrounding measurement marks in the left panel.

content_islands.name: Exclusion rule
content_islands.spec: Place the heading and instruction about graphics and text in the right column.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text links clear space with letting the logotype stand out.
reference_purposes.Application: The diagram shows the portrait lockup’s protected area.
reference_purposes.Constraint: No graphics or text may occupy the shown clear space.
